title: Add Redis-backed diary API
body:
Add a persistent API for dated diary entries.

- R1: POST /diaries accepts date, title, and body and returns the created entry as JSON.
- R2: GET /diaries returns entries in creation order.
- R3: Reject an invalid date or missing/empty required fields with HTTP 400 without adding an entry.
- R4: Keep diary data in Redis so it survives restarting only the API container. Add HTTP E2E tests.
